properties.name: loop_status says whether a real result ever came back, and a recorded reconcile stamps every check it compared
properties.rationale: An agreeing run left no trace, so a design could not tell "never fed a result back" from "every result matched" — the entry point of Anthony's founding chain was invisible. His word 2026-09-22 on both the reading and the stamp.
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: Step 3 of the approved ordering. New loop_closure module; LoopStatus.loop_closure plus a never_closed line in next (not counted in clean); reconcile_verification with record_events stamps last_reconciled_outcome / last_reconciled_at / last_failed_run_at on each observed check and returns `stamped`; three declared properties on Verification; where-am-i reads the reading beside the delivery line. (A sentence naming the stamp in the reconcile tool's description was tried and dropped — see fact:one-tools-description-sentence-made-two-other-tools-confusable.)
